text:
marta-partnerships: Quick alert from Nitro  they just flagged a supplier delay on connector harnesses affecting a small set of A100+H100 racks. Could hit a handful of Reserved activations in late-Oct. Raising here to coordinate.
cesar-nitro: Confirmed. Subcomponent recall impacting batches C-77/C-78. Rework ETA 10-14 days. We can do prioritized partial shipments if you supply a short list.
anya-sales: Which customers might see impact? we have acct-pegasus (marketplace co-sell launch) and acct-orbit (enterprise reserved). Pegasus launch is scheduled for 10/28.
tom-ops: Inventory shows 5 racks at risk across regions, peg & orbit included. If delayed, we should offer a fallback to marketplace VMs or a GPU-class swap.
remi-eng: Technical tradeoffs: A10 swap reduces throughput ~40% on our heavy models; marketplace VMs retain correctness but latency up ~25%. KV cache warmers essential on any failover.
marta-partnerships: @cesar-nitro can you hold 2 racks for priority if we send IDs by EOD and confirm expedite fees?
cesar-nitro: Yes. We can hold 2 racks for 12 hours. Expedite fee estimate = 8% of HW cost per rack. Need signed swap/expedite acknowledgement.
anya-sales: I'll call Pegasus and Orbit today. If Pegasus will accept marketplace fallback, we can avoid expedite for them.
claire-legal: Drafting a short expedite amendment template we can use for Nitro acks. Also adding language for crediting affected customers.
tom-ops: Suggestion: create short-term routing policy to split traffic 60/40 (marketplace/dedicated pending) with cache warming. Example snippet: ```
allocation_temp:
  target: reserved-pegasus
  fallback:
    - marketplace_eu_w1: 60%
    - dedicated_pending: 40%
  cache_warm: true
```
remi-eng: Also recommend increasing max_batch by 10% for fallback to smooth throughput.
marketplace-bot: SKU sku-rw-pegasus - region eu-west-1 - available_quota: 6 - provisioning_eta: 3 days for reserved VMs.
anya-sales: 3 days might still miss Pegasus launch. I'll offer them two options: expedite (8% fee) or fallback with 20% service credit for the first month.
cesar-nitro: Sending formal delay notice + QC summary to partnerships@redwood.com in 45m.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-1021 created by tom-ops - "Partner connector recall impacting Reserved activations" - priority P2.
marta-partnerships: Action items: @anya-sales customer decisions by EOD, @cesar-nitro formal notice + expedite terms, @claire-legal amendment draft, @tom-ops routing policy + incident owner, @remi-eng perf delta table and cache warmer scripts. We'll sync in partnerships standup tomorrow. :eyes:
